packages.name: Antalya & the Lycian Coast
packages.short_description: Old harbours, quiet coves, and the ruined cities of the Lycian shore.
packages.overview:
From Kaleiçi's stone alleys we move west along the coast — to the rock tombs of Myra, the sunken city of Kekova, and the long lunches that the Mediterranean demands.
Hotels are small and well-chosen. Three of the days are spent on a private wooden gulet, anchoring in coves only locals know.

packages.name: Pamukkale & Ephesus
packages.short_description: White travertine terraces and the marble streets of an ancient capital.
packages.overview:
Two of Turkey's most photographed sites, walked at the right hours and read with the right voices. Ephesus is opened by a classical archaeologist; Pamukkale is timed for late afternoon, when the terraces glow.
Between the two we lunch in Şirince, a hill village of stone houses and fruit wine, and sleep above the Aegean.

packages.name: Istanbul, Classics
packages.short_description: Hagia Sophia at first light, the Bosphorus at dusk, and the bazaars between.
packages.overview:
A measured, deliberate introduction to Istanbul — a city that does not reveal itself in a hurry. We move slowly through the old peninsula at the hours when the crowds are thin, then drift north along the Bosphorus to the quieter neighborhoods of Bebek and Arnavutköy.
Mornings are spent inside the great monuments. Afternoons unfold over long lunches and walks through Karaköy and Galata. Evenings are reserved — a private dinner above the strait, a hammam at the Çemberlitaş, a final raki on a wooden boat.

packages.name: Eastern Anatolia — Mount Nemrut & Lake Van
packages.short_description: Toppled stone heads at sunrise, an inland sea, and the deep east.
packages.overview:
Eastern Anatolia is the Turkey few visitors see. We move from the colossal heads of Mount Nemrut to the Armenian churches on Akdamar Island, and on to the high citadel of Hoşap.
Logistics here are the hardest part of any Turkey itinerary — which is why we plan it day-by-day with our most experienced fixers.

packages.name: Cappadocia & the Hot Air Balloons
packages.short_description: Sunrise above the fairy chimneys, then long afternoons in the valleys.
packages.overview:
Cappadocia is best understood from above and below. We rise before dawn for the balloons, then spend the rest of the day at ground level — walking the Rose and Red valleys, lunching in stone houses in Mustafapaşa, watching the light fall on Uçhisar.
Accommodation is in restored cave suites, not hotels pretending to be caves. Each evening ends with dinner on a quiet terrace.

packages.name: Black Sea & Sumela Monastery
packages.short_description: Cliffside monasteries, mountain plateaus, and the green of the Pontic Alps.
packages.overview:
The Black Sea coast is Turkey's quiet alternative — cooler, greener, and far from the cruise routes. We base in Trabzon and move inland to the Sumela Monastery and the high plateaus of Ayder.
Tea is taken seriously here. So is hospitality.

package_itinerary_days.title: A long breakfast, then home
package_itinerary_days.description: Slow morning. Private transfer to the airport.

package_itinerary_days.title: Galata, Pera, the new Istanbul
package_itinerary_days.description: Coffee in Karaköy, a long walk through Galata. Afternoon at the Pera Museum and Istanbul Modern. Hammam at Çemberlitaş.

package_itinerary_days.title: The Bosphorus, properly
package_itinerary_days.description: Private wooden boat from Bebek to Anadolu Kavağı. Lunch on the Asian shore. Evening at a restored Ottoman mansion overlooking the strait.

package_itinerary_days.title: Hagia Sophia, Cistern, Topkapı
package_itinerary_days.description: Skip-the-line morning entries with a licensed historian. Lunch at a chef-run kitchen in Eminönü. Afternoon at leisure in the Grand Bazaar.

package_itinerary_days.title: Arrival & the Old City at dusk
package_itinerary_days.description: Private transfer from IST. Late-afternoon walk through Sultanahmet as the call to prayer crosses the rooftops. Welcome dinner at a meyhane in Karaköy.

package_itinerary_days.title: Slow morning, return
package_itinerary_days.description: Optional second balloon flight. Transfer to Kayseri or onward.

package_itinerary_days.title: Underground cities & ceramic villages
package_itinerary_days.description: Morning in Derinkuyu's underground city. Lunch in Mustafapaşa. Visit to a working ceramic atelier in Avanos.

package_itinerary_days.title: Balloons at first light
package_itinerary_days.description: Pre-dawn balloon flight over the valleys. Long breakfast on return. Afternoon walking tour of the Rose & Red valleys.

package_itinerary_days.title: Arrival in Göreme
package_itinerary_days.description: Private transfer from Kayseri. Settle into your cave suite. Sunset at Uçhisar Castle, dinner in a stone-walled cellar.

package_itinerary_days.title: Return
package_itinerary_days.description: Slow morning at Hierapolis necropolis. Transfer to Denizli or Izmir.

package_itinerary_days.title: On to Pamukkale
package_itinerary_days.description: Drive inland through olive country. Late-afternoon walk on the travertines and a swim in the Cleopatra Pool. Dinner in Karahayıt.

package_itinerary_days.title: Ephesus, with an archaeologist
package_itinerary_days.description: Early morning entry to Ephesus before the cruise crowds. Lunch in Şirince. Afternoon at the House of the Virgin Mary.

package_itinerary_days.title: Izmir & the road to Selçuk
package_itinerary_days.description: Arrival at ADB. Private transfer to a country hotel near Selçuk. Welcome dinner of Aegean meze.

package_itinerary_days.title: Disembark & return
package_itinerary_days.description: Morning swim. Transfer to Antalya or Dalaman airport.

package_itinerary_days.title: Myra & the rock tombs
package_itinerary_days.description: Morning ashore at Myra. Afternoon at sea. Sunset anchor in a private cove.

package_itinerary_days.title: Kekova & the sunken city
package_itinerary_days.description: Swimming over Lycian ruins. Lunch on board. Anchor in Üçağız for the evening.

package_itinerary_days.title: On to the gulet
package_itinerary_days.description: Drive west to Kaş. Board a private wooden gulet for three nights at sea.

package_itinerary_days.title: Perge & Aspendos
package_itinerary_days.description: Two of the great Roman sites, with a classical historian. Lunch on the river at Köprülü.

package_itinerary_days.title: Arrival in Antalya
package_itinerary_days.description: Private transfer from AYT. Settle into a Kaleiçi boutique hotel. Evening walk to the old harbour.

package_itinerary_days.title: Return
package_itinerary_days.description: Slow morning. Transfer to Trabzon airport.

package_itinerary_days.title: Ayder plateau
package_itinerary_days.description: High mountain villages, wooden houses, and a hot spring at sundown.

package_itinerary_days.title: Uzungöl & the high country
package_itinerary_days.description: Morning at the lake. Afternoon at a working tea plantation in Of.

package_itinerary_days.title: Sumela Monastery
package_itinerary_days.description: Drive into the Altındere valley. Walk up to the cliff-face monastery. Lunch of trout in Maçka.

package_itinerary_days.title: Arrival in Trabzon
package_itinerary_days.description: Private transfer. Walk through the old town and Atatürk Köşkü.

package_itinerary_days.title: Return
package_itinerary_days.description: Transfer to Van airport (VAN).

package_itinerary_days.title: Akdamar Island & Hoşap Castle
package_itinerary_days.description: Boat to the Armenian Church of the Holy Cross. Afternoon at Hoşap.

package_itinerary_days.title: On to Lake Van
package_itinerary_days.description: Drive east. Evening swim in the lake; dinner with a local family.

package_itinerary_days.title: Diyarbakır
package_itinerary_days.description: The black basalt walls and the great mosque. Long lunch in a stone-walled courtyard.

package_itinerary_days.title: On to Şanlıurfa
package_itinerary_days.description: The pools of Abraham, Göbekli Tepe, and the bazaar at dusk.

package_itinerary_days.title: Mount Nemrut at sunrise
package_itinerary_days.description: Pre-dawn ascent to the eastern terrace. Breakfast at the summit. Visit Arsameia and the Cendere Bridge.

package_itinerary_days.title: Arrival in Adıyaman
package_itinerary_days.description: Private transfer. Evening at leisure.
